items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: who else was playing drums with Rene his brother Joe Rene

ctx.x: I was with the Handys band

I was with the Pelican I remember that see he was playing on the Pelican and he was playing on that story I remember that see yeah that's the time he had Dave Jones and son Duke no Dave Jones and Edgar Soshee Rene and who else was playing drums with Rene his brother Joe Rene
